title: PLEDGE: source code and reproduction package for "No Log, No Access: Ledger-Gated Attribute-Based Encryption for Accountable Sharing of FHIR Health Records"
description: Source code and reproduction package for PLEDGE, a FHIR-native health-record sharing system built on ledger-gated multi-authority attribute-based encryption: no log, no access. The package contains the PLEDGE implementation (LG-ABE on BLS12-381, threshold key-share services, FHIR Consent compiler, Hyperledger Fabric chaincode and gateway), re-implementations of three baseline systems, the attack suite, the Tamarin models, all benchmark scripts and the raw results reported in the paper.
